title: Aromatic Sweet Moroccan Yellow Onion Sellou
description: A jammy and bouncy Moroccan dish featuring yellow onion, perfect for a date night, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients and a lacquer glaze finish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, ginger, cinnamon, turmeric, and black pepper.
Add the sliced yellow onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the glaze.
Spread the onion mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the onion in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until caramelized.
While the onion is roasting, cook the dates in a saucepan with a little water over low heat until they are soft and jammy.
Once the onion is done, let it cool slightly before transferring it to a serving dish.
Top the onion with the cooked dates and serve warm.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
